summary.recommendation: Correct and measure first: repair confirmed defects, reconcile public claims, clarify branch attribution, and establish qualified-inquiry and booking baselines.

caveats: All observations are a dated public snapshot. Public pages and profile totals can change.
The inventory is a broad discovery map of mixed business models, not an exhaustive census or independent confirmation that every business is currently operating.

Inventory readiness measures observed capability presence, not content quality, business quality, SEO health or search ranking. Publish only for included records with at least five of six capabilities assessed.
Unknown and unassessed values are null, never zero. A zero means not observed in the assessed scope; it does not mean absent sitewide.
Deep ratings are separate 0–2 analyst judgments for sampled pages. Do not sum them into a composite rank or league table. Quote journeys were not interactively completed.
Google ratings, counts, photos, addresses and phone numbers belong to the exact sampled branch. Do not combine branches or present values as brand-wide totals.

Each Google review sample contains five Google-selected public cards, not the latest, random, representative or exhaustive reviews. Reply fractions describe those selected cards only and are not population response rates.
Rounded and sometimes edited review dates do not establish exact response speed. No response-speed SLA was measured.
Individual customer allegations in selected reviews are unverified, not established findings or prevalence estimates.
Raw HTML and rendered pages differ. The target has runtime-injected canonicals and metadata. Raw-source absence does not establish a missing rendered tag or a verified SEO defect.
Technical source detections do not prove correctness, indexation, rich-result eligibility, mobile quality or Core Web Vitals. Blocked or incomplete captures remain unknown.
Blue Whale’s Google profile was marked permanently closed and is historical/excluded. Do not include it among current active competitors or active profile benchmarks.
Published city targeting does not establish a branch or service availability. Company-published contact addresses are not independent confirmation of staffed premises or profile eligibility.
Website awards, policies, licensing, insurance and operating promises are published representations unless explicitly verified. The audit makes no legal or regulatory determination.
The 100 opportunities are a menu of verified fixes, maintenance, validation and experiments, not 100 established defects. Priorities and effort are proposed, not promised business impact.
No traffic, local-pack rank, search volume, domain authority, backlink census, conversion rate, revenue, Core Web Vitals or guaranteed ROI is inferred.

opportunities.title: Reconcile the founding year
opportunities.action: Confirm the operating-company founding date and any legitimate predecessor history, then correct all templates.

opportunities.title: Verify the national award claim
opportunities.action: Obtain the original award/result URL, correct award name/year/category, and citation. If it cannot be substantiated, remove or accurately replace the claim throughout the site.
opportunities.basis: Homepage/reviews claim a USA Today 2024 award; the office-moving guide explicitly says that award cannot be verified.
opportunities.measure: Every award claim links to primary evidence

opportunities.title: Publish one current guarantee policy
opportunities.action: Have the owner and appropriate insurance/legal reviewer confirm actual coverage and distinctions. Publish one clearly scoped summary and link to current terms from offers. This audit makes no legal coverage determination.
opportunities.basis: Reviews page advertises $10,000 full-value coverage; guarantee policy states up to $1,000 per move and describes exclusions and depreciated-value settlements. The website does not explain the difference between these offers.
opportunities.measure: No material conflicts across guarantee and booking pages

opportunities.title: Align referral offer details
opportunities.action: Ask the owner for the operative percentage and calculation base; use one formula, examples, eligibility and effective date everywhere. Confirm payment method and payout timing, then align steps, terms and confirmation messages.
opportunities.basis: Referral explanation calculates payouts at 10%; detailed local and out-of-state terms each specify 5%. Referral steps promise a nominated online payment method; terms later specify a company check.
opportunities.measure: One current referral offer across all public placements

opportunities.title: Clarify referral contact roles
opportunities.action: Use unmistakable labels for the advocate and referred customer, explain what contact will occur, and require appropriate permission before outreach. Track eligibility and payout without incentivizing positive reviews.
opportunities.basis: Referral form labels the second person section as referrer information even though instructions ask for the person being referred.
opportunities.measure: Referral form unambiguously distinguishes the advocate and referred customer

opportunities.title: Replace published source placeholders
opportunities.action: Replace SOURCE TBD placeholders with checked primary references, verify the associated cost statements and have an accountable reviewer approve the guide.
opportunities.basis: The inspected cost guide contains unresolved SOURCE TBD placeholders alongside useful cost guidance.
opportunities.measure: No source placeholders remain and all material cost claims have checked references

opportunities.title: Verify license identifiers and links
opportunities.action: Ask the owner for current official TxDMV and FMCSA licensing/insurance records and the correct service scope. Link current consumer-verifiable records once confirmed; do not present this audit as regulatory clearance or an allegation.
opportunities.basis: Website displays TXDMV008843498C, USDOT3352346 and MC1086275. Official SAFER snapshot available to this audit is dated 2026-09-15; identity matches and USDOT is Active. Its authority line names property except household goods, while cargo includes household goods. This audit did not resolve that distinction or verify current insurance/state authority.
opportunities.measure: Working official verification link for each relevant credential

opportunities.title: Attribute testimonials accurately

opportunities.basis: Validate the condition before implementation; the public audit does not establish this as a defect.
opportunities.measure: All retained testimonials have traceable source records

findings.title: Verify disputed automated link responses
findings.observation: The public claim remains withdrawn. Fresh visible local Edge and direct HTTP returned404 for all seven exact destinations; six source pages returned200. Owner/cached-search conflict remains to be reconciled.
findings.action: Record source URL and exact destination separately. Do not recommend repairs until the discrepancy is resolved.
findings.limit: Original automated status is not sufficient to establish normal-browser failure.

findings.title: Resolve referral percentage conflict
findings.observation: Referral explanation calculates payouts at 10%; detailed local and out-of-state terms each specify 5%.
findings.action: Ask the owner for the operative percentage and calculation base; use one formula, examples, eligibility and effective date everywhere.

findings.title: Resolve referral payment-method conflict
findings.observation: Referral steps promise a nominated online payment method; terms later specify a company check.
findings.action: Confirm payment method and payout timing, then align steps, terms and confirmation messages.

findings.title: Reconcile damage-coverage promises
findings.observation: Reviews page advertises $10,000 full-value coverage; guarantee policy states up to $1,000 per move and describes exclusions and depreciated-value settlements. The website does not explain the difference between these offers.
findings.action: Have the owner and appropriate insurance/legal reviewer confirm actual coverage and distinctions. Publish one clearly scoped summary and link to current terms from offers. This audit makes no legal coverage determination.

findings.title: Standardize business history
findings.observation: Homepage and Round Rock page say service began in 2019; reviews and the office-moving guide say 2013. BBB identifies business start/incorporation in 2019.
findings.action: Confirm the operating-company founding date and any legitimate predecessor history, then correct all templates.

findings.title: Resolve conflicting award statement
findings.evidence: Observed rendered + HTML; award not independently verified
findings.observation: Homepage/reviews claim a USA Today 2024 award; the office-moving guide explicitly says that award cannot be verified.
findings.action: Obtain the original award/result URL, correct award name/year/category, and citation. If it cannot be substantiated, remove or accurately replace the claim throughout the site.

findings.title: Clarify heavy-item fees
findings.observation: Reviews comparison promises no heavy-item charge; local-moving page describes an extra fee for items above 300 lb.
findings.action: Publish the actual heavy-item policy and make exclusions/thresholds consistent across comparison tables, service pages and estimates.

findings.title: Distinguish fixed quotes from hourly estimates
findings.observation: Homepage/Round Rock copy promises a final, unchanged quoted price. Local-moving page describes billing by the hour; FAQ says preparedness affects the final bill. Those can coexist only if scope and quote type are explained.
findings.action: Define binding quote versus estimated hours, clock start/stop, minimum, travel charge and scope changes. Show a worked example rather than implying all estimates are fixed-price.

findings.title: Surface payment fees before quote completion
findings.observation: FAQ says a 3% credit-card processing fee is passed to customers; the main pitch emphasizes no surprises.
findings.action: Confirm current card/cash/Venmo policy and disclose any applicable payment fee alongside quote/payment choices. Verify wording with the owner rather than alleging noncompliance.

findings.title: Replace four repeated Round Rock benefit cards
findings.observation: The visible Round Rock page repeats the same fixed-price benefit heading and paragraph four times and repeats the main reasons-to-choose heading.
findings.action: Restore four genuinely different, evidenced benefits and remove duplicate section copy.

findings.title: Repair Round Rock award-badge destinations
findings.observation: Forbes, Best of Austin and Best of Round Rock badges on the Round Rock page each link to the BBB profile. The reviews page has differentiated external destinations.
findings.action: Link each badge to its actual supporting result and ensure the image, award year and destination match.

findings.title: Correct footer Blog link
findings.evidence: Observed HTML; visibility varies by layout
findings.observation: Homepage HTML contains a correct header Blog link to /blog and a footer Blog link to /about. The latter exists in the page source; not all footer navigation is visible in the inspected desktop layout.
findings.action: Correct the shared footer href and test footer/mobile navigation after publishing.

findings.title: Proofread repeated trust copy
findings.observation: Homepage and shared/footer copy contain conspicuous misspellings in the company name, obligation and guarantee; Barton Hills page has a misspelled place-name subheading.
findings.action: Fix shared components first, then run editorial QA on high-intent pages.

findings.title: Remove location-template contamination
findings.observation: Cedar Park page includes a heading about new residents moving into Southwest Oaks, a different location.
findings.action: Review the entire city-page template and replace copied geographic assertions with verified local details and completed-job evidence.

findings.title: Reconcile historical addresses and phone roles
findings.evidence: Observed public sources; branch ownership needs confirmation
findings.observation: Current site/Chamber use 901 S MoPac Expy; BizRatings lists 9600 Great Hills Trl and the Round Rock phone; Renovations Up lists 3119 E 13th St. Travis Heights body uses 737-302-6566 while global navigation uses 737-230-6190. Some differences may be legitimate branches or tracking numbers.
findings.action: Create an owner-approved branch/phone/citation matrix, identify moved/closed offices, and correct only verified stale listings. Keep legitimate branch and call-tracking distinctions.

findings.title: Make metadata changes auditable across rendering
findings.observation: None of the 115 saved HTML responses contained a canonical tag. Rendered homepage, local-moving and referral pages gain correct self-canonicals. Referral title/description are also rewritten at runtime. Therefore a source-only claim that the site lacks canonicals or descriptions would be false.
findings.action: Choose a single source of truth for titles, descriptions and canonical URLs, preferably published in initial HTML when practical. Compare source, rendered HTML and Search Console-selected canonicals before changing anything.
findings.limit: A rendered Round Rock inspection returned no canonical; confirm that page specifically. No indexing loss was measured.

findings.title: Deduplicate and fact-check generated image schema
findings.observation: Homepage contains two 24-item ImageObject arrays; local-moving page contains two 13-item arrays. Some homepage captions reference Treemont or Highland Park West, and image licenses are set to Creative Commons.
findings.action: Remove redundant graph nodes and validate captions and license claims against the actual assets/rights. Use stable entity IDs and keep factual business information consistent.
findings.limit: No Rich Results Test eligibility or Google parsing result was obtained; syntactically valid JSON alone is not Google validation.

findings.title: Add an explicit, accurate Round Rock entity
findings.observation: Round Rock rendered page contains Organization and MovingCompany/LocalBusiness data for Austin headquarters. No separate Round Rock branch entity appeared in this inspection, although the visible page has branch-specific NAP.
findings.action: After verifying the staffed location and GBP, add a unique Round Rock entity ID, correct branch phone/address/hours/map and URL; relate it to the parent organization. HQ schema itself is not inherently wrong.

findings.title: Create a claims evidence register
findings.observation: Site asserts a 90% referral rate, 40% faster three-person crews, highest review rating and universal Texas-born crew. Public website evidence alone does not establish these claims.
findings.action: Record owner, data source, methodology, date and expiration for each numeric or superlative statement. Replace unsupported absolutes with accurate specifics.

findings.title: Map overlapping service URLs to intent
findings.evidence: Observed overlapping intent; SEO impact hypothesis
findings.observation: Local service intent is split across /local-moving-austin, /mover-austin and /mover-austin/local-moving-services-austin; long-distance intent exists both at root and under moving-and-storage. This is overlap, not proof of keyword cannibalization.
findings.action: Export Search Console query-to-page and conversion data, select primary landing pages, differentiate useful secondary intent, and consolidate only proven redundant pages with appropriate redirects.

findings.title: Review landmark-page usefulness before adding volume
findings.observation: Sitemap lists 486 URLs, including 169 /blog/ URLs, 19 /movers-round-rock/ URLs and 122 URLs containing -near-. Existing city pages provide localized access/parking context, but some show template contamination.
findings.action: Judge pages on distinct customer usefulness, real jobs, logistics and conversion contribution. Improve or merge weak overlaps instead of publishing more near-duplicate place-name pages. Quantity alone is not a spam violation.

findings.title: Add persistent accessible quote-field labels
findings.observation: Homepage and full quote forms have placeholders but no HTML label elements in the saved source. Homepage accessibility tree leaves email and phone fields unnamed. Referral form, by contrast, has associated labels.
findings.action: Give every quote input/select a persistent associated label or correct accessible name; add useful autocomplete and inputmode values. Test keyboard navigation, errors and screen-reader names.
findings.limit: This is a targeted observation, not a formal WCAG conformance audit.

findings.title: Test a shorter first-step quote flow
findings.observation: Homepage asks for six required fields plus optional message; full quote asks for nine required fields plus optional message and CAPTCHA. No completion rates are available.
findings.action: A/B test a short qualification step using origin/destination/date and an appropriate contact path, retaining a full-detail path for ready buyers. Measure qualified booked moves, not form volume alone.
findings.limit: Forms were not submitted, CAPTCHA not solved, CRM delivery untested.

findings.title: Separate general questions from detailed move quotes
findings.observation: Contact page invites general questions but embeds the full moving-quote form requiring property, bedrooms and move date.
findings.action: Offer a concise general-inquiry option and clear phone/hours; retain the detailed estimate form for quote requests. Add a realistic response-time promise once operations can meet it.

findings.title: Audit analytics and paid-lead attribution
findings.observation: Source includes Google Tag Manager, UTM/gclid hidden fields, lead-attribution script, two distinct Meta pixel initializations and PageView calls, review widgets and runtime SEO scripts. Presence does not prove events are firing correctly or twice.
findings.action: Use owner-authorized analytics/CRM access to verify unique lead IDs, deduplication, consent behavior, calls, booked moves, revenue and branch attribution. Test duplicate events before removing any tag.

findings.title: Establish real mobile performance baseline
findings.observation: Homepage worked in cloud Chrome at an approximately 1165x747 desktop viewport. Public PageSpeed API returned HTTP429 quota exceeded. No Lighthouse, CrUX, LCP, INP, CLS or mobile-device scores are available.
findings.action: Run PageSpeed/Lighthouse and real mobile tests for home, quote, city and service templates. Prioritize observed bottlenecks; investigate fonts, hero media and third-party widgets only if measured.
findings.limit: Do not interpret shell fetch time, HTML byte size or script count as Core Web Vitals.

findings.title: Verify licensing wording before expanding interstate claims
findings.observation: Website displays TXDMV008843498C, USDOT3352346 and MC1086275. Official SAFER snapshot available to this audit is dated 2026-09-15; identity matches and USDOT is Active. Its authority line names property except household goods, while cargo includes household goods. This audit did not resolve that distinction or verify current insurance/state authority.
findings.action: Ask the owner for current official TxDMV and FMCSA licensing/insurance records and the correct service scope. Link current consumer-verifiable records once confirmed; do not present this audit as regulatory clearance or an allegation.

findings.title: Replace generic assurance with completed-job evidence
findings.observation: Sampled service/city pages are detailed but mainly broad explanations. About page supplies a genuine company story and named crew profiles, a useful foundation for more original proof.
findings.action: Add owner-approved job case studies: neighborhood, property/access challenge, crew size, time, scope, protected items and a consented customer quote/photo. Link each to relevant city/service pages.

findings.title: Verify article authors and references
findings.observation: Office-moving article credits Alex Chen as a logistics specialist and provides a journal citation, while carrying inconsistent company history and award language. Author identity and the reference were not independently validated.
findings.action: Have a real accountable staff expert review the page; validate every external source and add author credentials and review date. Do not invent expertise or citations.

findings.title: Confirm breadth of storage and specialty services
findings.evidence: Observed service claims; operational verification unavailable
findings.observation: Site claims car, document, business, warehouse and climate-controlled storage along with piano/senior/packing services. Public copy does not establish owned versus partner facilities, capacity, access or all service limits.
findings.action: Confirm delivery model, availability, facility details and exclusions with the owner. Publish concrete service facts and photos only where accurate, then prioritize profitable service intent.

findings.title: Replace HTTP internal hrefs with final HTTPS URLs
findings.observation: Areas-served page contains multiple plain-http internal URLs even though HTTPS equivalents are listed in the sitemap. HTTP/non-www homepage tests resolve successfully to HTTPS www.
findings.action: Update shared/internal links to final HTTPS URLs and preserve working redirects. This is cleanup; no security incident or crawl failure was observed.

findings.title: Clarify referrer versus referred-person form labels
findings.observation: Referral form labels the second person section as referrer information even though instructions ask for the person being referred.
findings.action: Use unmistakable labels for the advocate and referred customer, explain what contact will occur, and require appropriate permission before outreach. Track eligibility and payout without incentivizing positive reviews.
